# Exploratory analysis

Goals

- Identify the best threshold to remove noise; improve quantitative predictions from ML

- plotting distributions

```{r loadStuff}
library(tidyverse, quietly = TRUE)
library(grid)

# import data
base_path <- "enrichment_data/theoAptzepPCR_lokya/"
data <- read_tsv(str_c(base_path, "subset.tsv"))
```

```{r plotting_functions}
#| fig-width: 2
#| fig-height: 3

annotation_generator <- function(max_x_val, max_y_val) { 
#' Generates a function to create text annotations for a plot.
#' Inputs:
#'   - max_x: the maximum x value in the plot (used to position the annotation)
#'   - max_y: the maximum y value in the plot (used to position the annotation)
#' Returns:
#'   - A function that takes x_scale, label_text, and y_offset as arguments and returns a ggplot2 annotation layer.

  function(x_scale = 0.6, label_text, y_offset) {
  # work in progress ;
  # make a text annotation to add to the plot; based on offset values for x and y
    annotate(geom = "text",
      x = max_x_val * x_scale, 
      y = 0 + y_offset * max_y_val/10, 
      label = label_text, 
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 3)
  }
}

nham_count_distribution <-  function(df, print_stats = FALSE) {

  # TODO: adjust the x and y positions of annotate() based on data max/ total fct counts etc.

  counts <- summarise(df, count = n(), .by = Nham_nt) # summarize to get variant counts at each Nham_nt value

  # calculate summaries for plotting
  snp_count <- counts |> filter(Nham_nt > 0) |> pull(count) |> sum()
  indel_count <- counts |> filter(is.na(Nham_nt)) |> pull(count)
  total_count <- nrow(df)

  # Calculate dynamic positions
  max_count <- max(counts$count, na.rm = FALSE)
  num_nham <- nrow(counts)
  add_annotation <- annotation_generator(max_x_val = max_count, max_y_val = num_nham) # create a function to add annotations to the plot
 
  if(print_stats) {
    # print stats
    cat("snp_count =", snp_count, "\nindel_count = ", indel_count, "\n")
    cat("total = ", total_count, "variants\n")
  }

  # Plot variant counts
  plt <- ggplot(counts, aes(count, fct_rev(as_factor(Nham_nt)))) + 
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) + 

    # annotations
    labs(x = "Number of variants", y = "Number of mismatches") + # axis labels
    geom_text(aes(label = count), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) + # count of each bar
    # summary variant counts: snps, indels, total
    add_annotation(label_text = str_c("snps: ", snp_count), y_offset = 2) +
    add_annotation(label_text = str_c("indels: ", indel_count), y_offset = 1.5) +
    add_annotation(label_text = str_c("total: ", total_count), y_offset = 1) +

    # aesthetics
    theme_bw() + 
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, .25))) # expand x-axis to make room for text annotations
  print(plt)
}

nham_count_distribution(head(data, 1000))
```

```{r threshold_test}
#| fig-width: 2
#| fig-height: 3

d1 <- data |> filter(if_any(matches("count"), \(ct) ct >= 2))

nham_count_distribution(d1)
```

```{r dummy-test}
#| fig-width: 2
#| fig-height: 3

dummy <- tibble(x = 1:10, y = x^2)

ggplot(dummy, aes(x, y)) + geom_point() + labs(title = "Dummy plot") + 
  annotation_custom(grob = textGrob(str_c("snps: ", snp_count), hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, gp = gpar(size = 3)), 
                  xmax = Inf-8, ymin = -Inf)

```
